interests:
Protection of the environment has always been an important issue;
Organised village level groups, to protect the flora and fauna of our local forest from timber mafias and poachers; Currently working on a project to rejuvenate our local lakes; Successfully fought for the cause of settlement of the Van Tangiya labour families living in the forests; Spearheaded the fight against the local Sand-Mafia at the ground level as well as in National Green Tribunal which ultimately resulted in heavy fines imposed on the offenders and the curbing of this ecologically harmful activity; work against local sand mafia
hobbies: Reading, photography, painting, wild-life and Eco-tourism and aero-modelling
sports: Archery, Water sports, Sport-fishing and Aero sports; To encourage the unique activity of aero sports in my rural area, have set up an Avadh Aero Sports Society and established an air strip which is registered with the Ministry of Civil Aviation, Government of India, where provide free air time experience to local youths and NCC cadets on Ultra-lite aircrafts

literary_activities: Promotion of new techniques in agriculture, tree-plantation and fisheries, successfully counducted a three year pilot project of cage-Farming of fish which was sponsored by the Ford foundation, with the objective of the optimum use of large water bodies and also the equi-distribution of the natural wealth among the weaker and economically backward sections of society
other_information: Education is an important issue for him as his district is economically backward and with a low literacy rate; with the object of economic development and upliftment of the weaker sections of the population, constantly tried for improvement in the standard of education being imparted as well as promoting education in the remote and interior areas of his constituency; actively assisted and organized the educated and unemployed youth to establish schools in remote villages and encourage these activities by organising cultural programmes and mobilising local support with the increasing realization of the importance of the education of girls in the rural society, established a Girls Inter college and also a degree college to impart higher education; apart from these, established two institutions, managing two inter colleges, and a higher secondary school
